title: ASSURANCE AND ATTESTATION SERVICES
description: Examines external financial statement auditing and assurance services. Introduces generally accepted auditing standards and the audit process. Covers audit planning, risk assessment, internal control evaluation and testing, audit evidence, substantive testing, analytical procedures, fraud considerations, and audit reporting. Emphasizes professional judgment and the role of auditing in enhancing the credibility of financial information.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ACTG 318.
A minimum grade of C- is required in ACTG 318.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Accountancy (641), Accounting (A016), Accounting (A017) or Accounting (C191).
